core.setting: Funeral home director at Holloway & Sons Funeral Services

events.text: Standing instruction for the office: any supplier order over £800 needs Tomas Reyes, our finance lead, to sign off before it is placed. Anything at £800 or under I can approve myself.
House rule: once a family's service booking is confirmed, the date or time of that service may not be moved without the family's own agreement. Always ask the family first.
Confirming our standard supply terms for Holloway & Sons: memorial candles at £2.40 each, boxed in twenties, delivery to your Chapel of Rest store room on Tuesdays and Fridays, payment on 30 days.

Our standing arrangement for Holloway & Sons still holds: standard white lily and rose coffin spray £145, double-ended spray £210, chapel pedestal pair £95, delivery to the Chapel of Rest by 09:00 on service days.
Price list for the year: orders of service booklets, 50 copies £180, 100 copies £260; memorial acknowledgement cards, 100 cards £120. Artwork turnaround three working days.

Fleet note: hearse one (the silver Daimler) is serviced and available all days; hearse two (the black Daimler) is booked for bodywork 9 to 13 November. Driver Edwin Marsh is available weekdays, driver Priya Shah weekdays except Wednesdays.
Delighted to keep taking services for Holloway & Sons. My regular availability: Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays, mornings or afternoons. My fee remains £180 per service, paid on the day.

Placed the standing fortnightly restock with Waxworth Candles: 200 memorial candles at £2.40 each, so £480, delivered to the Chapel of Rest store room on Fridays. Under my own approval limit so no further sign-off needed.
Staff meeting notes: chapel cleaning rota agreed, Edwin to keep the hearse log weekly, reminder that the organ tuner visits the first Monday of each month.

Nina Alder phoned about her father Arthur's service. The family would like Friday 23 October 2026 at 11:00 in our Chapel of Rest, Reverend June Calloway to officiate, burial afterwards at Rosehill Cemetery. About 60 mourners expected.
Yes, Friday 23 October at 11:00 suits me perfectly for the Alder service. Please have the order of service readings to me by Monday 19 October.

Confirmed the Alder service: Friday 23 October 2026, 11:00, Chapel of Rest, Reverend June Calloway officiating at her £180 fee, burial after at Rosehill Cemetery. Nina Alder confirmed the date and time herself on the phone, so the booking stands with the family's agreement.
Booked hearse one and Edwin Marsh for the Alder service on Friday 23 October: collect from the Chapel of Rest at 10:30, cortege to Rosehill Cemetery after the 11:00 service.

Ordered the Alder flowers with Bloom & Stem per the standing list: one standard white lily and rose coffin spray at £145 and a chapel pedestal pair at £95, total £240, delivered to the Chapel of Rest by 09:00 on Friday 23 October.
Ordered the Alder order of service booklets from Hale Memorial Print: 100 copies at £260, readings to follow by Monday 19 October so they make their three-day turnaround.
Thank you, Margot. The family is settled on Friday 23 October at 11:00. Please do not change anything about the time; several relatives are travelling down and trains are booked.

As requested, a quote for a premium tribute: full casket cover in autumn roses and oak foliage, £920, plus a matching garland for the chapel door at £160. Let me know if the Alder family would like this instead of the standard spray.
Invoice 4471: 200 memorial candles delivered 2 October, £480, payable within 30 days.

Just to restate the house purchasing rule in plain terms for the new office staff: Margot may approve supplier orders up to and including £800 on her own authority; anything dearer than that comes to me first for sign-off before the order goes out. Nothing about the rule has changed, this is only a clearer wording.

Following up on the premium casket cover quote at £920 for the Alder service — I can still source the autumn roses if you confirm by Thursday. The standard spray and pedestal order for 23 October is already scheduled either way.
Hearse one valeted and fuelled. Log updated. I am clear for the Alder funeral on the 23rd and will have the car at the chapel for 10:15 to be safe.
To-do: get the final Alder readings from Nina and send them to Hale Memorial Print by Monday 19 October, and to Reverend Calloway the same day.

Stock check courtesy note: your candle restock is due this Friday 16 October as usual — 200 candles, £480, store room delivery. Also, winter scented lines are now available if you ever want a sample box.
Final readings attached for Arthur's service, as promised. We are staying with the standard flowers — the premium cover is more than we want. See you Friday 23 October at 11:00.
